arxiv:2603.23405.title: Planning over MAPF Agent Dependencies via Multi-Dependency PIBT

arxiv:2603.23503.title: Optimal Unlabeled Pebble Motion on Trees and its Application to Multi-Agent Path Finding

arxiv:2603.26684.title: Decoupling Geometric Planning and Execution in Scalable Multi-Agent Path Finding
